Music theory practice, in three parts. Use the list on the left to move around, or **Previous** and **Next** at the foot of each page to
go through it like a book.

## Drills and exercises

- [**Theory Drills**](theory-drills.qmd): every drill on the site in one place: notes, intervals, key signatures, chords, Roman numerals
  and more. Each has its own settings, and a link can open a drill with your settings.
- [**Exercise Builder**](exercise-builder.qmd): choose chapters and build a set of exercises, answered on the page or printed.

## The textbook, chapter by chapter

Each page goes with a chapter of Robert Hutchinson's open textbook
[*Music Theory for the 21st-Century Classroom*](https://musictheory.pugetsound.edu/mt21c/). Read the chapter there first, then practise
here.

| Chapter | Page |
|---|---|
| 2 | [Major Scales and Key Signatures](major-scales.qmd) (from movable do) |
| 4 | [Basics of Rhythm](rhythm-basics.qmd) (from du de) |
| 6 | [Triads](triads.qmd) |
| 7 | [Roman Numerals](roman-numerals.qmd) |
| 8 | [Seventh Chords](seventh-chords.qmd) |
| 9 | [Harmonic Progression](progressions.qmd) |
| 10 | [Non-Chord Tones](non-chord-tones.qmd) |
| 11 | [Melodic Analysis](melodic-analysis.qmd) |
| 12 | [Form in Popular Music](pop-forms.qmd) |
| 14 | [Accompanimental Textures](accompaniment-textures.qmd) |
| 16 | [Figured Bass](figured-bass.qmd) |
| 17 | [Secondary Dominants](secondary-dominants.qmd) |
| 18 | [Secondary Diminished Chords](secondary-diminished.qmd) |
| 19 | [Mode Mixture](mode-mixture.qmd) |
| 20 | [The Neapolitan Chord](neapolitan.qmd) |
| 21 | [Augmented Sixth Chords](augmented-sixths.qmd) |
| 22 | [Modulation](modulation.qmd) |
| 31 | [Jazz Theory](jazz-theory.qmd) |

## Analysed scores

[**Analysed Scores**](analysed-scores/index.qmd): real pieces with experts' Roman numerals under the notes, one piece per page, to play
along with: [Bach's "O Haupt voll Blut und Wunden"](analysed-scores/bach-o-haupt.qmd) and the first movement of
[Beethoven's "Moonlight" Sonata](analysed-scores/beethoven-moonlight-1.qmd).
